text:
For your one-hour morning commute, I recommend podcasts that offer deep literary analysis or engaging author interviews to replace your lost reading time. "The New York Times Book Review" is an excellent choice, featuring in-depth discussions with authors and critics. Another great option is "99% Invisible," which, while not strictly literary, offers deep dives into design and culture that appeal to avid readers. For pure author interviews, "The Writer's Voice" or "Literary Hub's The Book Club" provide insightful conversations with contemporary writers.

The drink that comes from cows is milk.
